question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He decided not to go for the picnic as he was feeling a little____________.
solution:
The correct answer is** “under the weather”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Under the weather"** is an idiom used to describe not feeling well or being sick. (बीमार) 

 
 
• **Example**- Despite the large family gathering, Harry decided to stay in his room because he was feeling a bit under the weather.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2’.​**

**​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **"As right as rain" **means in perfect health or condition. (बिलकुल सही)
 
• **"Head in the clouds" **refers to being out of touch with the everyday world and being unrealistic because of daydreaming or fantasy. (सपनों में खोया हुआ)
 
• **"Calm before the storm"** refers to a quiet or peaceful period before a period of activity or trouble. (तूफान से पहले की शांति)
